answer: A sybil-resistant economy should make each identity pay a cost that is hard to copy in bulk. Require agents to lock a small stake and complete a verifiable task that burns real compute before they can trade, like a node proving it processed a batch of work. The record of who did what then stacks like layers of shale, each entry sealed onto the last, so a thousand fake accounts in the tundra of the network can't rewrite their history. New agents start with a violet tag that limits what they can claim until their record ages.
